abbott_smith_html:
δίδωμι,
[in LXX chiefly for נָתַן (53 words in all) ;]
to give—in various senses, accusative to context—bestow, grant, supply, deliver, commit, yield: absol., Act.20:35; with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), Mat.4:9 5:31, Jhn.1:12, al. mult.; with dative of person(s), before ἐκ, Mat.25:8; id. with genitive part.. Rev.2:17; with accusative of person(s), Jhn.3:16, Rev.20:13, al.; δεξιάς, Gal.2:9; φίλημα, Luk.7:45; γνῶσιν, Luk.1:77; κρίσιν, Jhn.5:22; of seed yielding fruit, Mrk.4:7, 8; ἐργασίαν (Deiss., LAE, 117f.), Luk.12:58; with inf. fin., Mat.27:34, Mrk.5:43, Luk.8:55, Jhn.6:52, al.; with dative of person(s) and inf., Luk.1:74, al.; with accusative and inf., Act.2:27, Rev.3:9; with dupl. accusative, Mat.20:28, Mrk.10:45, Eph.1:22 4:11, 2Th.3:9, 1Ti.2:6, al.; ἑαυτὸν δ. εἰς (Polyb., al.), Act.19:31; with dative of person(s), before κατά (MM, Exp., xi), Rev.2:28 (LXX); δ. ἵνα, Rev.3:9; δέδωκα ἐνώπιόν σου θύραν ἀνεῳγμένην, Rev.3:8.
SYN.: δωρέομαι. (AS)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to give (used in a very wide application, properly, or by implication, literally or figuratively; greatly modified by the connection)
strongs_1890.derivation: a prolonged form of a primary verb (which is used as an alternative in most of the tenses);
strongs_1890.kjv_def: adventure, bestow, bring forth, commit, deliver (up), give, grant, hinder, make, minister, number, offer, have power, put, receive, set, shew, smite (+ with the hand), strike (+ with the palm of the hand), suffer, take, utter, yield

occurrences.kjv: Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.

occurrences.bsb: Give, and it will be given to you. A good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over will be poured into your lap. For with the measure you use, it will be measured back to you.”
occurrences.kjv: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.

occurrences.bsb: And the dead man sat up and began to speak! Then Jesus gave him back to his mother.
occurrences.kjv: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.

occurrences.bsb: And turning toward the woman, He said to Simon, “Do you see this woman? When I entered your house, you did not give Me water for My feet, but she wet My feet with her tears and wiped them with her hair.
occurrences.kjv: And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thine house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head.

occurrences.bsb: You did not greet Me with a kiss, but she has not stopped kissing My feet since I arrived.
occurrences.kjv: Thou gavest me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet.

occurrences.bsb: He replied, “The knowledge of the mysteries of the kingdom of God has been given to you, but to others I speak in parables, so that, ‘though seeing, they may not see; though hearing, they may not understand.’
occurrences.kjv: And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God: but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.

occurrences.bsb: Pay attention, therefore, to how you listen. Whoever has will be given more, but whoever does not have, even what he thinks he has will be taken away from him.”
occurrences.kjv: Take heed therefore how ye hear: for whosoever hath, to him shall be given; and whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he seemeth to have.

occurrences.bsb: Her spirit returned, and at once she got up. And He directed that she be given something to eat.
occurrences.kjv: And her spirit came again, and she arose straightway: and he commanded to give her meat.

occurrences.bsb: Then Jesus called the Twelve together and gave them power and authority over all demons, and power to cure diseases.
occurrences.kjv: Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all devils, and to cure diseases.

occurrences.bsb: But Jesus told them, “You give them something to eat.” “We have only five loaves of bread and two fish,” they answered, “unless we go and buy food for all these people.”
occurrences.kjv: But he said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they said, We have no more but five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy meat for all this people.

occurrences.bsb: Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, Jesus spoke a blessing and broke them. Then He gave them to the disciples to set before the people.
occurrences.kjv: Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed them, and brake, and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude.

occurrences.bsb: Behold, I have given you authority to tread on snakes and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will harm you.
occurrences.kjv: Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.

occurrences.bsb: The next day he took out two denarii and gave them to the innkeeper. ‘Take care of him,’ he said, ‘and on my return I will repay you for any additional expense.’
occurrences.kjv: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.

occurrences.bsb: Give us each day our daily bread.
occurrences.kjv: Give us day by day our daily bread.

occurrences.bsb: And suppose the one inside answers, ‘Do not bother me. My door is already shut, and my children and I are in bed. I cannot get up to give you anything.’
occurrences.kjv: And he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee.

occurrences.bsb: I tell you, even though he will not get up to provide for him because of his friendship, yet because of the man’s persistence, he will get up and give him as much as he needs.
occurrences.kjv: I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth.

occurrences.bsb: So I tell you: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.
occurrences.kjv: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.

occurrences.bsb: So if you who are evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give the Holy Spirit to those who ask Him!”
occurrences.kjv: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?

occurrences.bsb: As the crowds were increasing, Jesus said, “This is a wicked generation. It demands a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of Jonah.
occurrences.kjv: And when the people were gathered thick together, he began to say, This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.

occurrences.bsb: But give as alms the things that are within you, and behold, everything will be clean for you.
occurrences.kjv: But rather give alms of such things as ye have; and, behold, all things are clean unto you.

occurrences.bsb: Do not be afraid, little flock, for your Father is pleased to give you the kingdom.
occurrences.kjv: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the kingdom.

occurrences.bsb: Sell your possessions and give to the poor. Provide yourselves with purses that will not wear out, an inexhaustible treasure in heaven, where no thief approaches and no moth destroys.
occurrences.kjv: Sell that ye have, and give alms; provide yourselves bags which wax not old, a treasure in the heavens that faileth not, where no thief approacheth, neither moth corrupteth.

occurrences.bsb: And the Lord answered, “Who then is the faithful and wise manager, whom the master puts in charge of his servants to give them their portion at the proper time?
occurrences.kjv: And the Lord said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall make ruler over his household, to give them their portion of meat in due season?

occurrences.bsb: But the one who unknowingly does things worthy of punishment will be beaten with few blows. From everyone who has been given much, much will be required; and from him who has been entrusted with much, even more will be demanded.
occurrences.kjv: But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes. For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.

occurrences.bsb: Do you think that I have come to bring peace to the earth? No, I tell you, but division.
occurrences.kjv: Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division:

occurrences.bsb: Make every effort to reconcile with your adversary while you are on your way to the magistrate. Otherwise, he may drag you off to the judge, and the judge may hand you over to the officer, and the officer may throw you into prison.
occurrences.kjv: When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate, as thou art in the way, give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him; lest he hale thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and the officer cast thee into prison.

occurrences.bsb: Then the host who invited both of you will come and tell you, ‘Give this man your seat.’ And in humiliation, you will have to take the last place.
occurrences.kjv: And he that bade thee and him come and say to thee, Give this man place; and thou begin with shame to take the lowest room.

occurrences.bsb: The younger son said to him, ‘Father, give me my share of the estate.’ So he divided his property between them.
occurrences.kjv: And the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth to me. And he divided unto them his living.

occurrences.bsb: He longed to fill his belly with the pods the pigs were eating, but no one would give him a thing.
occurrences.kjv: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.

occurrences.bsb: But the father said to his servants, ‘Quick! Bring the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his finger and sandals on his feet.
occurrences.kjv: But the father said to his servants, Bring forth the best robe, and put it on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet:

occurrences.bsb: But he answered his father, ‘Look, all these years I have served you and never disobeyed a commandment of yours. Yet you never gave me even a young goat so I could celebrate with my friends.
occurrences.kjv: And he answering said to his father, Lo, these many years do I serve thee, neither transgressed I at any time thy commandment: and yet thou never gavest me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends:

occurrences.bsb: And if you have not been faithful with the belongings of another, who will give you belongings of your own?
occurrences.kjv: And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another man’s, who shall give you that which is your own?

occurrences.bsb: Was no one found except this foreigner to return and give glory to God?”
occurrences.kjv: There are not found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger.

occurrences.bsb: Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus, glorifying God. And all the people, when they saw it, gave praise to God.
occurrences.kjv: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto God.

occurrences.bsb: But Zacchaeus stood up and said to the Lord, “Look, Lord, half of my possessions I give to the poor, and if I have cheated anyone, I will repay it fourfold.”
occurrences.kjv: And Zaccheus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.

occurrences.bsb: Beforehand, he called ten of his servants and gave them ten minas. ‘Conduct business with this until I return,’ he said.
occurrences.kjv: And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said unto them, Occupy till I come.

occurrences.bsb: When he returned from procuring his kingship, he summoned the servants to whom he had given the money, to find out what each one had earned.
occurrences.kjv: And it came to pass, that when he was returned, having received the kingdom, then he commanded these servants to be called unto him, to whom he had given the money, that he might know how much every man had gained by trading.

occurrences.bsb: Why then did you not deposit my money in the bank, and upon my return I could have collected it with interest?’
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore then gavest not thou my money into the bank, that at my coming I might have required mine own with usury?

occurrences.bsb: Then he told those standing by, ‘Take the mina from him and give it to the one who has ten minas.’
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto them that stood by, Take from him the pound, and give it to him that hath ten pounds.

occurrences.bsb: He replied, ‘I tell you that everyone who has will be given more; but the one who does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.
occurrences.kjv: For I say unto you, That unto every one which hath shall be given; and from him that hath not, even that he hath shall be taken away from him.

occurrences.bsb: “Tell us,” they said, “by what authority are You doing these things, and who gave You this authority?”
occurrences.kjv: And spake unto him, saying, Tell us, by what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?

occurrences.bsb: At harvest time, he sent a servant to the tenants to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the tenants beat the servant and sent him away empty-handed.
occurrences.kjv: And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent him away empty.

occurrences.bsb: He will come and kill those tenants and give the vineyard to others.” And when the people heard this, they said, “May such a thing never happen!”
occurrences.kjv: He shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the vineyard to others. And when they heard it, they said, God forbid.

occurrences.bsb: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar or not?”
occurrences.kjv: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Cesar, or no?

occurrences.bsb: For I will give you speech and wisdom that none of your adversaries will be able to resist or contradict.
occurrences.kjv: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.

occurrences.bsb: They were delighted and agreed to give him money.
occurrences.kjv: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.

occurrences.bsb: And He took the bread, gave thanks and broke it, and gave it to them, saying, “This is My body, given for you; do this in remembrance of Me.”
occurrences.kjv: And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it, and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.

occurrences.bsb: And they began to accuse Him, saying, “We found this man subverting our nation, forbidding payment of taxes to Caesar, and proclaiming Himself to be Christ, a King.”
occurrences.kjv: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Cesar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.

occurrences.bsb: But to all who did receive Him, to those who believed in His name, He gave the right to become children of God—
occurrences.kjv: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:

occurrences.bsb: For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: So they said to him, “Who are you? We need an answer for those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”
occurrences.kjv: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?

occurrences.bsb: For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.
occurrences.kjv: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

occurrences.bsb: John replied, “A man can receive only what is given him from heaven.
occurrences.kjv: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.

occurrences.bsb: For the One whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for God gives the Spirit without limit.
occurrences.kjv: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.

occurrences.bsb: The Father loves the Son and has placed all things in His hands.
occurrences.kjv: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.

occurrences.bsb: So He came to a town of Samaria called Sychar, near the plot of ground that Jacob had given to his son Joseph.
occurrences.kjv: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

occurrences.bsb: When a Samaritan woman came to draw water, Jesus said to her, “Give Me a drink.”
occurrences.kjv: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered, “If you knew the gift of God and who is asking you for a drink, you would have asked Him, and He would have given you living water.”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.

occurrences.bsb: Are You greater than our father Jacob, who gave us this well and drank from it himself, as did his sons and his livestock?”
occurrences.kjv: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?

occurrences.bsb: But whoever drinks the water I give him will never thirst. Indeed, the water I give him will become in him a fount of water springing up to eternal life.”
occurrences.kjv: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

occurrences.bsb: The woman said to Him, “Sir, give me this water so that I will not get thirsty and have to keep coming here to draw water.”
occurrences.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.

occurrences.bsb: Furthermore, the Father judges no one, but has assigned all judgment to the Son,
occurrences.kjv: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:

occurrences.bsb: For as the Father has life in Himself, so also He has granted the Son to have life in Himself.
occurrences.kjv: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;

occurrences.bsb: And He has given Him authority to execute judgment, because He is the Son of Man.
occurrences.kjv: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.

occurrences.bsb: But I have testimony more substantial than that of John. For the works that the Father has given Me to accomplish—the very works I am doing—testify about Me that the Father has sent Me.
occurrences.kjv: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.

occurrences.bsb: Do not work for food that perishes, but for food that endures to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you. For on Him God the Father has placed His seal of approval.”
occurrences.kjv: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.

occurrences.bsb: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, as it is written: ‘He gave them bread from heaven to eat.’”
occurrences.kjv: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus said to them, “Truly, truly, I tell you, it was not Moses who gave you the bread from heaven, but it is My Father who gives you the true bread from heaven.
occurrences.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.

occurrences.bsb: For the bread of God is He who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world.”
occurrences.kjv: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.

occurrences.bsb: “Sir,” they said, “give us this bread at all times.”
occurrences.kjv: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.

occurrences.bsb: Everyone the Father gives Me will come to Me, and the one who comes to Me I will never drive away.
occurrences.kjv: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.

occurrences.bsb: And this is the will of Him who sent Me, that I shall lose none of those He has given Me, but raise them up at the last day.
occurrences.kjv: And this is the Father’s will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.

occurrences.bsb: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. And this bread, which I will give for the life of the world, is My flesh.”
occurrences.kjv: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.

occurrences.bsb: At this, the Jews began to argue among themselves, “How can this man give us His flesh to eat?”
occurrences.kjv: The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?

occurrences.bsb: Then Jesus said, “This is why I told you that no one can come to Me unless the Father has granted it to him.”
occurrences.kjv: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.

occurrences.bsb: Has not Moses given you the law? Yet not one of you keeps it. Why are you trying to kill Me?”
occurrences.kjv: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?

occurrences.bsb: But because Moses gave you circumcision, you circumcise a boy on the Sabbath (not that it is from Moses, but from the patriarchs.)
occurrences.kjv: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.

occurrences.bsb: So a second time they called for the man who had been blind and said, “Give glory to God! We know that this man is a sinner.”
occurrences.kjv: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.

occurrences.bsb: I give them eternal life, and they will never perish. No one can snatch them out of My hand.
occurrences.kjv: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.

occurrences.bsb: My Father who has given them to Me is greater than all. No one can snatch them out of My Father’s hand.
occurrences.kjv: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father’s hand.

occurrences.bsb: But even now I know that God will give You whatever You ask of Him.”
occurrences.kjv: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.

occurrences.bsb: But the chief priests and Pharisees had given orders that anyone who knew where He was must report it, so that they could arrest Him.
occurrences.kjv: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew it, that they might take him.

occurrences.bsb: “Why wasn’t this perfume sold for three hundred denarii and the money given to the poor?”
occurrences.kjv: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?

occurrences.bsb: I have not spoken on My own, but the Father who sent Me has commanded Me what to say and how to say it.
occurrences.kjv: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus knew that the Father had delivered all things into His hands, and that He had come from God and was returning to God.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;

occurrences.bsb: I have set you an example so that you should do as I have done for you.
occurrences.kjv: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered, “It is the one to whom I give this morsel after I have dipped it.” Then He dipped the morsel and gave it to Judas son of Simon Iscariot.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it. And when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.

occurrences.bsb: Since Judas kept the money bag, some thought that Jesus was telling him to buy what was needed for the feast, or to give something to the poor.
occurrences.kjv: For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.

occurrences.bsb: A new commandment I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you also must love one another.
occurrences.kjv: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.

occurrences.bsb: And I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Advocate to be with you forever—
occurrences.kjv: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;

occurrences.bsb: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.
occurrences.kjv: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

occurrences.bsb: You did not choose Me, but I chose you. And I appointed you to go and bear fruit—fruit that will remain—so that whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.
occurrences.kjv: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.

occurrences.bsb: In that day you will no longer ask Me anything. Truly, truly, I tell you, whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.
occurrences.kjv: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.

occurrences.bsb: For You granted Him authority over all people, so that He may give eternal life to all those You have given Him.
occurrences.kjv: As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.

occurrences.bsb: I have glorified You on earth by accomplishing the work You gave Me to do.
occurrences.kjv: I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.

occurrences.bsb: I have revealed Your name to those You have given Me out of the world. They were Yours; You gave them to Me, and they have kept Your word.
occurrences.kjv: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.

occurrences.bsb: Now they know that everything You have given Me comes from You.
occurrences.kjv: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.

occurrences.bsb: For I have given them the words You gave Me, and they have received them. They knew with certainty that I came from You, and they believed that You sent Me.
occurrences.kjv: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.

occurrences.bsb: I ask on their behalf. I do not ask on behalf of the world, but on behalf of those You have given Me; for they are Yours.
occurrences.kjv: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine.

occurrences.bsb: I will no longer be in the world, but they are in the world, and I am coming to You. Holy Father, protect them by Your name, the name You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one.
occurrences.kjv: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we are.

occurrences.bsb: While I was with them, I protected and preserved them by Your name, the name You gave Me. Not one of them has been lost, except the son of destruction, so that the Scripture would be fulfilled.
occurrences.kjv: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.

occurrences.bsb: I have given them Your word and the world has hated them. For they are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
occurrences.kjv: I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

occurrences.bsb: I have given them the glory You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one—
occurrences.kjv: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:

occurrences.bsb: Father, I want those You have given Me to be with Me where I am, that they may see the glory You gave Me because You loved Me before the foundation of the world.
occurrences.kjv: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.

occurrences.bsb: This was to fulfill the word He had spoken: “I have not lost one of those You have given Me.”
occurrences.kjv: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.

occurrences.bsb: “Put your sword back in its sheath!” Jesus said to Peter. “Shall I not drink the cup the Father has given Me?”
occurrences.kjv: Then said Jesus unto Peter, Put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?

occurrences.bsb: When Jesus had said this, one of the officers standing nearby slapped Him in the face and said, “Is this how You answer the high priest?”
occurrences.kjv: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?

occurrences.bsb: And they went up to Him again and again, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and slapping Him in the face.
occurrences.kjv: And said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they smote him with their hands.

occurrences.bsb: and he went back into the Praetorium. “Where are You from?” he asked. But Jesus gave no answer.
occurrences.kjv: And went again into the judgment hall, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered, “You would have no authority over Me if it were not given to you from above. Therefore the one who handed Me over to you is guilty of greater sin.”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power at all against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus came and took the bread and gave it to them, and He did the same with the fish.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus then cometh, and taketh bread, and giveth them, and fish likewise.

occurrences.bsb: Then they cast lots, and the lot fell to Matthias. So he was added to the eleven apostles.
occurrences.kjv: And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.

occurrences.bsb: And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other tongues as the Spirit enabled them.
occurrences.kjv: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.

occurrences.bsb: I will show wonders in the heavens above and signs on the earth below, blood and fire and billows of smoke.
occurrences.kjv: And I will shew wonders in heaven above, and signs in the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and vapour of smoke:

occurrences.bsb: because You will not abandon my soul to Hades, nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.
occurrences.kjv: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell, neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

occurrences.bsb: But Peter said, “Silver or gold I do not have, but what I have I give you: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!”
occurrences.kjv: Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.

occurrences.bsb: By faith in the name of Jesus, this man whom you see and know has been made strong. It is Jesus’ name and the faith that comes through Him that has given him this complete healing in your presence.
occurrences.kjv: And his name through faith in his name hath made this man strong, whom ye see and know: yea, the faith which is by him hath given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.

occurrences.bsb: Salvation exists in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to men by which we must be saved.”
occurrences.kjv: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.

occurrences.bsb: And now, Lord, consider their threats, and enable Your servants to speak Your word with complete boldness,
occurrences.kjv: And now, Lord, behold their threatenings: and grant unto thy servants, that with all boldness they may speak thy word,

occurrences.bsb: God exalted Him to His right hand as Prince and Savior, in order to grant repentance and forgiveness of sins to Israel.
occurrences.kjv: Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.

occurrences.bsb: We are witnesses of these things, and so is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey Him.”
occurrences.kjv: And we are his witnesses of these things; and so is also the Holy Ghost, whom God hath given to them that obey him.

occurrences.bsb: He gave him no inheritance here, not even a foot of ground. But God promised to give possession of the land to Abraham and his descendants, even though he did not yet have a child.
occurrences.kjv: And he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when as yet he had no child.

occurrences.bsb: Then God gave Abraham the covenant of circumcision, and Abraham became the father of Isaac and circumcised him on the eighth day. And Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob of the twelve patriarchs.
occurrences.kjv: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision: and so Abraham begat Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs.

occurrences.bsb: and rescued him from all his troubles. He granted Joseph favor and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt, who appointed him ruler over Egypt and all his household.
occurrences.kjv: And delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house.

occurrences.bsb: He assumed his brothers would understand that God was using him to deliver them, but they did not.
occurrences.kjv: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.

occurrences.bsb: He was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel who spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers. And he received living words to pass on to us.
occurrences.kjv: This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sina, and with our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us:

occurrences.bsb: When Simon saw that the Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money.
occurrences.kjv: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles’ hands the Holy Ghost was given, he offered them money,

occurrences.bsb: “Give me this power as well,” he said, “so that everyone on whom I lay my hands may receive the Holy Spirit.”
occurrences.kjv: Saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay hands, he may receive the Holy Ghost.

occurrences.bsb: Peter took her by the hand and helped her up. Then he called the saints and widows and presented her to them alive.
occurrences.kjv: And he gave her his hand, and lifted her up, and when he had called the saints and widows, presented her alive.

occurrences.bsb: God raised Him up on the third day and caused Him to be seen—
occurrences.kjv: Him God raised up the third day, and shewed him openly;

occurrences.bsb: So if God gave them the same gift He gave us who believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I to hinder the work of God?”
occurrences.kjv: Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us, who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ; what was I, that I could withstand God?

occurrences.bsb: When they heard this, they had no further objections, and they glorified God, saying, “So then, God has granted even the Gentiles repentance unto life.”
occurrences.kjv: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.

occurrences.bsb: Immediately, because Herod did not give glory to God, an angel of the Lord struck him down, and he was eaten by worms and died.
occurrences.kjv: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him, because he gave not God the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost.

occurrences.bsb: All this took about 450 years. After this, God gave them judges until the time of Samuel the prophet.
occurrences.kjv: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.

occurrences.bsb: Then the people asked for a king, and God gave them Saul son of Kish, from the tribe of Benjamin, who ruled forty years.
occurrences.kjv: And afterward they desired a king: and God gave unto them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.

occurrences.bsb: In fact, God raised Him from the dead, never to see decay. As He has said: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings promised to David.’
occurrences.kjv: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he said on this wise, I will give you the sure mercies of David.

occurrences.bsb: So also, He says in another Psalm: ‘You will not let Your Holy One see decay.’
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore he saith also in another psalm, Thou shalt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

occurrences.bsb: So Paul and Barnabas spent considerable time there, speaking boldly for the Lord, who affirmed the message of His grace by enabling them to perform signs and wonders.
occurrences.kjv: Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord, which gave testimony unto the word of his grace, and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands.

occurrences.bsb: Yet He has not left Himself without testimony to His goodness: He gives you rain from heaven and fruitful seasons, filling your hearts with food and gladness.”
occurrences.kjv: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.

occurrences.bsb: And God, who knows the heart, showed His approval by giving the Holy Spirit to them, just as He did to us.
occurrences.kjv: And God, which knoweth the hearts, bare them witness, giving them the Holy Ghost, even as he did unto us;

occurrences.bsb: Nor is He served by human hands, as if He needed anything, because He Himself gives everyone life and breath and everything else.
occurrences.kjv: Neither is worshipped with men’s hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he giveth to all life, and breath, and all things;

occurrences.bsb: Even some of Paul’s friends who were officials of the province of Asia sent word to him, begging him not to venture into the theatre.
occurrences.kjv: And certain of the chief of Asia, which were his friends, sent unto him, desiring him that he would not adventure himself into the theatre.

occurrences.bsb: And now I commit you to God and to the word of His grace, which can build you up and give you an inheritance among all who are sanctified.
occurrences.kjv: And now, brethren, I commend you to God, and to the word of his grace, which is able to build you up, and to give you an inheritance among all them which are sanctified.

occurrences.bsb: In everything, I showed you that by this kind of hard work we must help the weak, remembering the words of the Lord Jesus Himself: ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’”
occurrences.kjv: I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.

occurrences.bsb: At the same time, he was hoping that Paul would offer him a bribe. So he sent for Paul frequently and talked with him.
occurrences.kjv: He hoped also that money should have been given him of Paul, that he might loose him: wherefore he sent for him the oftener, and communed with him.

occurrences.bsb: Yet he did not waver through disbelief in the promise of God, but was strengthened in his faith and gave glory to God,
occurrences.kjv: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;

occurrences.bsb: And hope does not disappoint us, because God has poured out His love into our hearts through the Holy Spirit, whom He has given us.
occurrences.kjv: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.

occurrences.bsb: as it is written: “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that could not see, and ears that could not hear, to this very day.”
occurrences.kjv: (According as it is written, God hath given them the spirit of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear;) unto this day.

occurrences.bsb: For by the grace given me I say to every one of you: Do not think of yourself more highly than you ought, but think of yourself with sober judgment, according to the measure of faith God has given you.
occurrences.kjv: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.

occurrences.bsb: We have different gifts according to the grace given us. If one’s gift is prophecy, let him use it in proportion to his faith;
occurrences.kjv: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;

occurrences.bsb: Do not avenge yourselves, beloved, but leave room for God’s wrath. For it is written: “Vengeance is Mine; I will repay, says the Lord.”
occurrences.kjv: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: So then, each of us will give an account of himself to God.
occurrences.kjv: So then every one of us shall give account of himself to God.

occurrences.bsb: Now may the God who gives endurance and encouragement grant you harmony with one another in Christ Jesus,
occurrences.kjv: Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to Christ Jesus:

occurrences.bsb: However, I have written you a bold reminder on some points, because of the grace God has given me
occurrences.kjv: Nevertheless, brethren, I have written the more boldly unto you in some sort, as putting you in mind, because of the grace that is given to me of God,

occurrences.bsb: I always thank my God for you because of the grace He has given you in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: I thank my God always on your behalf, for the grace of God which is given you by Jesus Christ;

occurrences.bsb: What then is Apollos? And what is Paul? They are servants through whom you believed, as the Lord has assigned to each his role.
occurrences.kjv: Who then is Paul, and who is Apollos, but ministers by whom ye believed, even as the Lord gave to every man?

occurrences.bsb: By the grace God has given me, I laid a foundation as an expert builder, and someone else is building on it. But each one must be careful how he builds.
occurrences.kjv: According to the grace of God which is given unto me, as a wise masterbuilder, I have laid the foundation, and another buildeth thereon. But let every man take heed how he buildeth thereupon.

occurrences.bsb: Now about virgins, I have no command from the Lord, but I give a judgment as one who by the Lord’s mercy is trustworthy.
occurrences.kjv: Now concerning virgins I have no commandment of the Lord: yet I give my judgment, as one that hath obtained mercy of the Lord to be faithful.

occurrences.bsb: If others have this right to your support, shouldn’t we have it all the more? But we did not exercise this right. Instead, we put up with anything rather than hinder the gospel of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: If others be partakers of this power over you, are not we rather? Nevertheless we have not used this power; but suffer all things, lest we should hinder the gospel of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: but that if a woman has long hair, it is her glory? For long hair is given to her as a covering.
occurrences.kjv: But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair is given her for a covering.

occurrences.bsb: Now to each one the manifestation of the Spirit is given for the common good.
occurrences.kjv: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal.

occurrences.bsb: To one there is given through the Spirit the message of wisdom, to another the message of knowledge by the same Spirit,
occurrences.kjv: For to one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom; to another the word of knowledge by the same Spirit;

occurrences.bsb: whereas our presentable parts have no such need. But God has composed the body and has given greater honor to the parts that lacked it,
occurrences.kjv: For our comely parts have no need: but God hath tempered the body together, having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked:

occurrences.bsb: Even in the case of lifeless instruments, such as the flute or harp, how will anyone recognize the tune they are playing unless the notes are distinct?
occurrences.kjv: And even things without life giving sound, whether pipe or harp, except they give a distinction in the sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped?

occurrences.bsb: Again, if the trumpet sounds a muffled call, who will prepare for battle?
occurrences.kjv: For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself to the battle?

occurrences.bsb: So it is with you. Unless you speak intelligible words with your tongue, how will anyone know what you are saying? You will just be speaking into the air.
occurrences.kjv: So likewise ye, except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for ye shall speak into the air.

occurrences.bsb: But God gives it a body as He has designed, and to each kind of seed He gives its own body.
occurrences.kjv: But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body.

occurrences.bsb: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ!
occurrences.kjv: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: placed His seal on us, and put His Spirit in our hearts as a pledge of what is to come.
occurrences.kjv: Who hath also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.

occurrences.bsb: And it is God who has prepared us for this very purpose and has given us the Spirit as a pledge of what is to come.
occurrences.kjv: Now he that hath wrought us for the selfsame thing is God, who also hath given unto us the earnest of the Spirit.

occurrences.bsb: We are not commending ourselves to you again. Instead, we are giving you an occasion to be proud of us, so that you can answer those who take pride in appearances rather than in the heart.
occurrences.kjv: For we commend not ourselves again unto you, but give you occasion to glory on our behalf, that ye may have somewhat to answer them which glory in appearance, and not in heart.

occurrences.bsb: All this is from God, who reconciled us to Himself through Christ and gave us the ministry of reconciliation:
occurrences.kjv: And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation;

occurrences.bsb: We put no obstacle in anyone’s way, so that no one can discredit our ministry.
occurrences.kjv: Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:

occurrences.bsb: Now, brothers, we want you to know about the grace that God has given the churches of Macedonia.
occurrences.kjv: Moreover, brethren, we do you to wit of the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia;

occurrences.bsb: And not only did they do as we expected, but they gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us, through the will of God.
occurrences.kjv: And this they did, not as we hoped, but first gave their own selves to the Lord, and unto us by the will of God.

occurrences.bsb: And this is my opinion about what is helpful for you in this matter: Last year you were the first not only to give, but even to have such a desire.
occurrences.kjv: And herein I give my advice: for this is expedient for you, who have begun before, not only to do, but also to be forward a year ago.

occurrences.bsb: As it is written: “He has scattered abroad His gifts to the poor; His righteousness endures forever.”
occurrences.kjv: (As it is written, He hath dispersed abroad; he hath given to the poor: his righteousness remaineth for ever.

occurrences.bsb: For even if I boast somewhat excessively about the authority the Lord gave us for building you up rather than tearing you down, I will not be ashamed.
occurrences.kjv: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which the Lord hath given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:

occurrences.bsb: or because of these surpassingly great revelations. So to keep me from becoming conceited, I was given a thorn in my flesh, a messenger of Satan, to torment me.
occurrences.kjv: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.

occurrences.bsb: This is why I write these things while absent, so that when I am present I will not need to be severe in my use of the authority that the Lord gave me for building you up, not for tearing you down.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification, and not to destruction.

occurrences.bsb: who gave Himself for our sins to rescue us from the present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father,
occurrences.kjv: Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:

occurrences.bsb: And recognizing the grace that I had been given, James, Cephas, and John—those reputed to be pillars—gave me and Barnabas the right hand of fellowship, so that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcised.
occurrences.kjv: And when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given unto me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go unto the heathen, and they unto the circumcision.

occurrences.bsb: Is the law, then, opposed to the promises of God? Certainly not! For if a law had been given that could impart life, then righteousness would certainly have come from the law.
occurrences.kjv: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.

occurrences.bsb: But the Scripture pronounces all things confined by sin, so that by faith in Jesus Christ the promise might be given to those who believe.
occurrences.kjv: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.

occurrences.bsb: What then has become of your blessing? For I can testify that, if it were possible, you would have torn out your eyes and given them to me.
occurrences.kjv: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.

occurrences.bsb: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the glorious Father, may give you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in your knowledge of Him.
occurrences.kjv: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:

occurrences.bsb: And God put everything under His feet and made Him head over everything for the church,
occurrences.kjv: And hath put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church,

occurrences.bsb: Surely you have heard about the stewardship of God’s grace that was given to me for you,
occurrences.kjv: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to you-ward:

occurrences.bsb: I became a servant of this gospel by the gift of God’s grace, given me through the working of His power.
occurrences.kjv: Whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of God given unto me by the effectual working of his power.

occurrences.bsb: Though I am less than the least of all the saints, this grace was given me: to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,
occurrences.kjv: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;

occurrences.bsb: I ask that out of the riches of His glory He may strengthen you with power through His Spirit in your inner being,
occurrences.kjv: That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man;

occurrences.bsb: Now to each one of us grace has been given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: This is why it says: “When He ascended on high, He led captives away, and gave gifts to men.”
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore he saith, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men.

occurrences.bsb: And it was He who gave some to be apostles, some to be prophets, some to be evangelists, and some to be pastors and teachers,
occurrences.kjv: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;

occurrences.bsb: and do not give the devil a foothold.
occurrences.kjv: Neither give place to the devil.

occurrences.bsb: Let no unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building up the one in need and bringing grace to those who listen.
occurrences.kjv: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.

occurrences.bsb: Pray also for me, that whenever I open my mouth, words may be given me so that I will boldly make known the mystery of the gospel,
occurrences.kjv: And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,

occurrences.bsb: I became its servant by the commission God gave me to fully proclaim to you the word of God,
occurrences.kjv: Whereof I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you, to fulfil the word of God;

occurrences.bsb: For you know the instructions we gave you by the authority of the Lord Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: For ye know what commandments we gave you by the Lord Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: Anyone, then, who rejects this command does not reject man but God, the very One who gives you His Holy Spirit.
occurrences.kjv: He therefore that despiseth, despiseth not man, but God, who hath also given unto us his holy Spirit.

occurrences.bsb: in blazing fire, inflicting vengeance on those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ:

occurrences.bsb: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ Himself and God our Father, who by grace has loved us and given us eternal comfort and good hope,
occurrences.kjv: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,

occurrences.bsb: Not that we lack this right, but we wanted to offer ourselves as an example for you to imitate.
occurrences.kjv: Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us.

occurrences.bsb: Now may the Lord of peace Himself give you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with all of you.
occurrences.kjv: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.

occurrences.bsb: who gave Himself as a ransom for all—the testimony that was given at just the right time.
occurrences.kjv: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.

occurrences.bsb: Do not neglect the gift that is in you, which was given you through the prophecy spoken over you at the laying on of the hands of the elders.
occurrences.kjv: Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.

occurrences.bsb: So I advise the younger widows to marry, have children, and manage their households, denying the adversary occasion for slander.
occurrences.kjv: I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.

occurrences.bsb: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
occurrences.kjv: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

occurrences.bsb: He has saved us and called us to a holy calling, not because of our works, but by His own purpose and by the grace He granted us in Christ Jesus before time began.
occurrences.kjv: Who hath saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began,

occurrences.bsb: May the Lord grant mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, because he has often refreshed me and was unashamed of my chains.
occurrences.kjv: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:

occurrences.bsb: May the Lord grant Onesiphorus His mercy on that day. You know very well how much he ministered to me in Ephesus.
occurrences.kjv: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.

occurrences.bsb: Consider what I am saying, for the Lord will give you insight into all things.
occurrences.kjv: Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.

occurrences.bsb: He must gently reprove those who oppose him, in the hope that God may grant them repentance leading to a knowledge of the truth.
occurrences.kjv: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;

occurrences.bsb: He gave Himself for us to redeem us from all lawlessness and to purify for Himself a people for His own possession, zealous for good deeds.
occurrences.kjv: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.

occurrences.bsb: And again: “I will put My trust in Him.” And once again: “Here am I, and the children God has given Me.”
occurrences.kjv: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold I and the children which God hath given me.

occurrences.bsb: Consider how great Melchizedek was: Even the patriarch Abraham gave him a tenth of the plunder.
occurrences.kjv: Now consider how great this man was, unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.

occurrences.bsb: For this is the covenant I will make with the house of Israel after those days, declares the Lord. I will put My laws in their minds and inscribe them on their hearts. And I will be their God, and they will be My people.
occurrences.kjv: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people:

occurrences.bsb: “This is the covenant I will make with them after those days, declares the Lord. I will put My laws in their hearts and inscribe them on their minds.”
occurrences.kjv: This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, saith the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;

occurrences.bsb: Now if any of you lacks wisdom, he should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to him.
occurrences.kjv: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.

occurrences.bsb: If one of you tells him, “Go in peace; stay warm and well fed,” but does not provide for his physical needs, what good is that?
occurrences.kjv: And one of you say unto them, Depart in peace, be ye warmed and filled; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body; what doth it profit?

occurrences.bsb: But He gives us more grace. This is why it says: “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
occurrences.kjv: But he giveth more grace. Wherefore he saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble.

occurrences.bsb: Again he prayed, and the heavens gave rain, and the earth yielded its crops.
occurrences.kjv: And he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.

occurrences.bsb: Through Him you believe in God, who raised Him from the dead and glorified Him; and so your faith and hope are in God.
occurrences.kjv: Who by him do believe in God, that raised him up from the dead, and gave him glory; that your faith and hope might be in God.

occurrences.bsb: Young men, in the same way, submit yourselves to your elders. And all of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because, “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
occurrences.kjv: Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.

occurrences.bsb: Consider also that our Lord’s patience brings salvation, just as our beloved brother Paul also wrote you with the wisdom God gave him.
occurrences.kjv: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you;

occurrences.bsb: Behold what manner of love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God. And that is what we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it did not know Him.
occurrences.kjv: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.

occurrences.bsb: And this is His commandment: that we should believe in the name of His Son, Jesus Christ, and we should love one another just as He commanded us.
occurrences.kjv: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever keeps His commandments remains in God, and God in him. And by this we know that He remains in us: by the Spirit He has given us.
occurrences.kjv: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us.

occurrences.bsb: By this we know that we remain in Him, and He in us: He has given us of His Spirit.
occurrences.kjv: Hereby know we that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.

occurrences.bsb: And this is that testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.
occurrences.kjv: And this is the record, that God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone sees his brother committing a sin not leading to death, he should ask God, who will give life to those who commit this kind of sin. There is a sin that leads to death; I am not saying he should ask regarding that sin.
occurrences.kjv: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.

occurrences.bsb: And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we may know Him who is true; and we are in Him who is true—in His Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.
occurrences.kjv: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.

occurrences.bsb: This is the revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave Him to show His servants what must soon come to pass. He made it known by sending His angel to His servant John,
occurrences.kjv: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave unto him, to shew unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass; and he sent and signified it by his angel unto his servant John:

occurrences.bsb: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will grant the right to eat from the tree of life in the Paradise of God.
occurrences.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of God.

occurrences.bsb: Do not fear what you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison to test you, and you will suffer tribulation for ten days. Be faithful even unto death, and I will give you the crown of life.
occurrences.kjv: Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.

occurrences.bsb: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will give the hidden manna. I will also give him a white stone inscribed with a new name, known only to the one who receives it.
occurrences.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knoweth saving he that receiveth it.

occurrences.bsb: Even though I have given her time to repent of her immorality, she is unwilling.
occurrences.kjv: And I gave her space to repent of her fornication; and she repented not.

occurrences.bsb: Then I will strike her children dead, and all the churches will know that I am the One who searches minds and hearts, and I will repay each of you according to your deeds.
occurrences.kjv: And I will kill her children with death; and all the churches shall know that I am he which searcheth the reins and hearts: and I will give unto every one of you according to your works.

occurrences.bsb: And to the one who overcomes and continues in My work until the end, I will give authority over the nations.
occurrences.kjv: And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations:

occurrences.bsb: And I will give him the morning star.
occurrences.kjv: And I will give him the morning star.

occurrences.bsb: I know your deeds. Behold, I have placed before you an open door, which no one can shut. I know that you have only a little strength, yet you have kept My word and have not denied My name.
occurrences.kjv: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.

occurrences.bsb: As for those who belong to the synagogue of Satan, who claim to be Jews but are liars instead, I will make them come and bow down at your feet, and they will know that I love you.
occurrences.kjv: Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.

occurrences.bsb: To the one who overcomes, I will grant the right to sit with Me on My throne, just as I overcame and sat down with My Father on His throne.
occurrences.kjv: To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne, even as I also overcame, and am set down with my Father in his throne.

occurrences.bsb: And whenever the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to the One seated on the throne, who lives forever and ever,
occurrences.kjv: And when those beasts give glory and honour and thanks to him that sat on the throne, who liveth for ever and ever,

occurrences.bsb: So I looked and saw a white horse, and its rider held a bow. And he was given a crown, and he rode out to overcome and conquer.
occurrences.kjv: And I saw, and behold a white horse: and he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given unto him: and he went forth conquering, and to conquer.

occurrences.bsb: Then another horse went forth. It was bright red, and its rider was granted permission to take away peace from the earth and to make men slay one another. And he was given a great sword.
occurrences.kjv: And there went out another horse that was red: and power was given to him that sat thereon to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another: and there was given unto him a great sword.

occurrences.bsb: Then I looked and saw a pale green horse. Its rider’s name was Death, and Hades followed close behind. And they were given authority over a fourth of the earth, to kill by sword, by famine, by plague, and by the beasts of the earth.
occurrences.kjv: And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.

occurrences.bsb: Then each of them was given a white robe and told to rest a little while longer until the full number of their fellow servants, their brothers, were killed, just as they had been killed.
occurrences.kjv: And white robes were given unto every one of them; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellowservants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they were, should be fulfilled.

occurrences.bsb: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, with the seal of the living God. And he called out in a loud voice to the four angels who had been given power to harm the land and the sea:
occurrences.kjv: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God: and he cried with a loud voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea,

occurrences.bsb: And I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and they were given seven trumpets.
occurrences.kjv: And I saw the seven angels which stood before God; and to them were given seven trumpets.

occurrences.bsb: Then another angel, who had a golden censer, came and stood at the altar. He was given much incense to offer, along with the prayers of all the saints, on the golden altar before the throne.
occurrences.kjv: And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer; and there was given unto him much incense, that he should offer it with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.

occurrences.bsb: Then the fifth angel sounded his trumpet, and I saw a star that had fallen from heaven to earth, and it was given the key to the pit of the Abyss.
occurrences.kjv: And the fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star fall from heaven unto the earth: and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit.

occurrences.bsb: And out of the smoke, locusts descended on the earth, and they were given power like that of the scorpions of the earth.
occurrences.kjv: And there came out of the smoke locusts upon the earth: and unto them was given power, as the scorpions of the earth have power.

occurrences.bsb: The locusts were not given power to kill them, but only to torment them for five months, and their torment was like the stinging of a scorpion.
occurrences.kjv: And to them it was given that they should not kill them, but that they should be tormented five months: and their torment was as the torment of a scorpion, when he striketh a man.

occurrences.bsb: And I went to the angel and said, “Give me the small scroll.” “Take it and eat it,” he said. “It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.”
occurrences.kjv: And I went unto the angel, and said unto him, Give me the little book. And he said unto me, Take it, and eat it up; and it shall make thy belly bitter, but it shall be in thy mouth sweet as honey.

occurrences.bsb: Then I was given a measuring rod like a staff and was told, “Go and measure the temple of God and the altar, and count the number of worshipers there.
occurrences.kjv: And there was given me a reed like unto a rod: and the angel stood, saying, Rise, and measure the temple of God, and the altar, and them that worship therein.

occurrences.bsb: But exclude the courtyard outside the temple. Do not measure it, because it has been given over to the nations, and they will trample the holy city for 42 months.
occurrences.kjv: But the court which is without the temple leave out, and measure it not; for it is given unto the Gentiles: and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty and two months.

occurrences.bsb: And I will empower my two witnesses, and they will prophesy for 1,260 days, clothed in sackcloth.”
occurrences.kjv: And I will give power unto my two witnesses, and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred and threescore days, clothed in sackcloth.

occurrences.bsb: And in that hour there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city collapsed. Seven thousand were killed in the quake, and the rest were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.
occurrences.kjv: And the same hour was there a great earthquake, and the tenth part of the city fell, and in the earthquake were slain of men seven thousand: and the remnant were affrighted, and gave glory to the God of heaven.

occurrences.bsb: The nations were enraged, and Your wrath has come. The time has come to judge the dead and to reward Your servants the prophets, as well as the saints and those who fear Your name, both small and great—and to destroy those who destroy the earth.”
occurrences.kjv: And the nations were angry, and thy wrath is come, and the time of the dead, that they should be judged, and that thou shouldest give reward unto thy servants the prophets, and to the saints, and them that fear thy name, small and great; and shouldest destroy them which destroy the earth.

occurrences.bsb: But the woman was given two wings of a great eagle to fly from the presence of the serpent to her place in the wilderness, where she was nourished for a time, and times, and half a time.
occurrences.kjv: And to the woman were given two wings of a great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness, into her place, where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.

occurrences.bsb: The beast I saw was like a leopard, with the feet of a bear and the mouth of a lion. And the dragon gave the beast his power and his throne and great authority.
occurrences.kjv: And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard, and his feet were as the feet of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion: and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.
