occurrences.bsb: They worshiped the dragon who had given authority to the beast, and they worshiped the beast, saying, “Who is like the beast, and who can wage war against it?”
occurrences.kjv: And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast: and they worshipped the beast, saying, Who is like unto the beast? who is able to make war with him?

occurrences.bsb: The beast was given a mouth to speak arrogant and blasphemous words, and authority to act for 42 months.
occurrences.kjv: And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies; and power was given unto him to continue forty and two months.

occurrences.bsb: Then the beast was permitted to wage war against the saints and to conquer them, and it was given authority over every tribe and people and tongue and nation.
occurrences.kjv: And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them: and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.

occurrences.bsb: Because of the signs it was given to perform on behalf of the first beast, it deceived those who dwell on the earth, telling them to make an image to the beast that had been wounded by the sword and yet had lived.
occurrences.kjv: And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast; saying to them that dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and did live.

occurrences.bsb: The second beast was permitted to give breath to the image of the first beast, so that the image could speak and cause all who refused to worship it to be killed.
occurrences.kjv: And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed.

occurrences.bsb: And the second beast required all people, small and great, rich and poor, free and slave, to receive a mark on their right hand or on their forehead,
occurrences.kjv: And he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads:

occurrences.bsb: And he said in a loud voice, “Fear God and give Him glory, because the hour of His judgment has come. Worship the One who made the heavens and the earth and the sea and the springs of waters.”
occurrences.kjv: Saying with a loud voice, Fear God, and give glory to him; for the hour of his judgment is come: and worship him that made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and the fountains of waters.

occurrences.bsb: Then one of the four living creatures gave the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.
occurrences.kjv: And one of the four beasts gave unto the seven angels seven golden vials full of the wrath of God, who liveth for ever and ever.

occurrences.bsb: For they have spilled the blood of saints and prophets, and You have given them blood to drink, as they deserve.”
occurrences.kjv: For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets, and thou hast given them blood to drink; for they are worthy.

occurrences.bsb: Then the fourth angel poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was given power to scorch the people with fire.
occurrences.kjv: And the fourth angel poured out his vial upon the sun; and power was given unto him to scorch men with fire.

occurrences.bsb: And the people were scorched by intense heat, and they cursed the name of God, who had authority over these plagues. Yet they did not repent and give Him glory.
occurrences.kjv: And men were scorched with great heat, and blasphemed the name of God, which hath power over these plagues: and they repented not to give him glory.

occurrences.bsb: The great city was split into three parts, and the cities of the nations collapsed. And God remembered Babylon the great and gave her the cup of the wine of the fury of His wrath.
occurrences.kjv: And the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell: and great Babylon came in remembrance before God, to give unto her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.

occurrences.bsb: These kings have one purpose: to yield their power and authority to the beast.
occurrences.kjv: These have one mind, and shall give their power and strength unto the beast.

occurrences.bsb: For God has put it into their hearts to carry out His purpose by uniting to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God are fulfilled.
occurrences.kjv: For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will, and to agree, and give their kingdom unto the beast, until the words of God shall be fulfilled.

occurrences.bsb: As much as she has glorified herself and lived in luxury, give her the same measure of torment and grief. In her heart she says, ‘I sit as queen; I am not a widow and will never see grief.’
occurrences.kjv: How much she hath glorified herself, and lived deliciously, so much torment and sorrow give her: for she saith in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall see no sorrow.

occurrences.bsb: She was given clothing of fine linen, bright and pure.” For the fine linen she wears is the righteous acts of the saints.
occurrences.kjv: And to her was granted that she should be arrayed in fine linen, clean and white: for the fine linen is the righteousness of saints.

occurrences.bsb: Then I saw the thrones, and those seated on them had been given authority to judge. And I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for their testimony of Jesus and for the word of God, and those who had not worshiped the beast or its image and had not received its mark on their foreheads or hands. And they came to life and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.
occurrences.kjv: And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given unto them: and I saw the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Jesus, and for the word of God, and which had not worshipped the beast, neither his image, neither had received his mark upon their foreheads, or in their hands; and they lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years.

occurrences.bsb: The sea gave up its dead, and Death and Hades gave up their dead, and each one was judged according to his deeds.
occurrences.kjv: And the sea gave up the dead which were in it; and death and hell delivered up the dead which were in them: and they were judged every man according to their works.

occurrences.bsb: And He told me, “It is done! I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. To the thirsty I will give freely from the spring of the water of life.
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto me, It is done. I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely.
